18 Punta Cana hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Punta Cana hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 18 Punta Cana hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Billabook.com at 2, Barcelo.com at 1, Evendo at 1, pricetravel.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1, Traveluro at 1, Tripadvisor.com at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them. These are the Punta Cana rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Punta Cana hotels

At the 8 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 28% ($56 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 18% at Ocean El Faro to 28% at Caribe Deluxe Princess. At 4 hotels the before-tax going rate was the same as the all-in one: the sites reported no taxes or fees on top. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
